command.seatRule: authenticated_seat is derived from cookie/session by authoritative server; never trust payload seat or team
command.pendingRule: one immutable in-flight command per authenticated human seat; retry the identical canonical packet after ACK loss
command.receiptRule: commit once, persist receipt before sending success ACK; duplicate identical request returns byte-compatible ACK across seal/restart; changed request rejected
command.orderingRule: neither SSE nor HTTP ACK independently increments client_sequence twice; reconcile to max(serverNext, ackSeq+1) exactly once after receipt
command.epochRule: room change or reauth resets sequence/revision state; late response from old epoch ignored
command.readyRule: ready is a distinct idempotent request with same epoch/round/seat key; no simulation until both humans confirm

server_state.cursorRule: SSE event ids, monotonic per seat/room epoch. Gaps -> fresh authorized filtered snapshot; do not reuse numeric revision across rooms without epoch
